authorization: User: please implement and execute this design we are discussing. Includes the finite prototype, independent review, result recording and canonical repository publication.
finish_line: One preserved canonical attempt; at most four exact prefix model passes, exactly two surrogate/prior solves when prerequisites pass, one accepted or retained transaction, independent review and publication. No original fitter/learner rerun, automatic retry, extra anchor or longer campaign.

inputs.input_only_scan: Before any model call stream and validate exactly the prefix, preserving index/order and bits; compute charge extrema including zero using I*dt/3600 and sequential addition, as in the model. No source generation or resampling.

representation.prior: One common supported mixture of the public Gaussian kernels with density in entering x. Condition the mixture as a whole. The common support normalizer cancels in cost contrasts; no normalized evidence or posterior moments are claimed.
representation.replacement_anchor: Mapped original free historical fit; no new full nonlinear optimum is sought. This supplied anchor is not an autonomous anchor-selection result.
representation.support: Declared entering box and SOC path feasibility at both prefix charge extrema; strict nonnegative raw slacks before all model passes. No point clipping or arithmetic-slack admission.
representation.model: Unchanged src/scm_model.c and include/scm_model.h; same illustrative OCV and3RC hysteresis.

sequence: Input-only validation and anchor feasibility; zero model steps.
old_anchor: construct full likelihood cost, gradient and Gram.
replacement_anchor: construct full likelihood block, check saved-free cost/Gram parity.
One solve_worker child: frozen and replacement surrogate/prior solves, one identical start each, durable per-solve started/completed/exception markers.
frozen_audit: evaluate finite strictly feasible frozen candidate under exact nonlinear history.
replacement_audit: evaluate finite strictly feasible replacement candidate under exact nonlinear history.
Compare identical-prior computed costs and atomically accept replacement or retain old active block.

solver_policy.derivatives: Analytic full objective gradient/Hessian and two SOC constraint Jacobians/Hessians; no finite differences in solves
solver_policy.coordinate_map: x=common_warm_start + diag(public_unsplit_SD)*u; same origin/scales for both arms; x density base measure unchanged
solver_policy.objective_offset: Drop each quadratic's constant value at the common warm start from its optimizer objective only; preserve it in every reported cost
solver_policy.constraint_scale: SOC path slacks divided by public unsplit SOC SD; box constraints in u
solver_policy.evaluation_accounting: Every actual objective/gradient kernel evaluation, any Hessian-triggered evaluation, and one forced final verification consume the same cap; final slot reserved. Cached Hessians and callback logging do not evaluate an objective. Raw SciPy nfev/njev/nhev also reported.
solver_policy.stopping_rationale: gtol equals the independently checked numerical KKT tolerance; initial barrier is1/64 of that tolerance because SciPy can report gtol success before its barrier complementarity is small
solver_policy.KKT_checks: Relative scaled stationarity, absolute scaled complementarity and dual violation <=KKT tolerance; strict raw feasibility and optimizer success additionally required for converged status
solver_policy.feasibility_arithmetic: Compute SOC using charge/exp(logQ), matching model order. Report gamma(64)*max(1,operand magnitudes) allowances separately; raw negative slacks are never clipped or accepted for model evaluation
solver_policy.linear_algebra: No eigenvalue clipping, pseudoinverse covariance, covariance repair or curvature inversion; unmodified spectra reported diagnostically. trust-constr QR may fall back to SVD for constrained optimization; all emitted warnings are recorded and this does not define a posterior covariance.
solver_policy.curvature_interpretation: Local surrogate and prior curvature only; no calibrated intervals, supported moments or posterior probabilities
solver_policy.thread_policy: Supervisor sets single-thread BLAS environment before importing numpy/scipy; this module never changes process-global thread settings

solver_qualification.status: Qualified finite solver with explicit limitations; two hard fabricated cases accurate and feasible but KKT-unresolved. Earlier receipts preserved.
solver_qualification.feasible_unresolved_candidates: Receive the two already-budgeted exact-cost audits. Raw success never overrides independent KKT.
solver_qualification.generic_exception: Preserve partial per-solve markers/results and stop remaining model passes; no retry.

numerical_rules.parity: Cost and mapped full Gram checked with gamma(8*N+128) times the sum of absolute computed accumulation/reference scales. Coordinate map is the exact local H*h0 chain with legacy coordinate scales removed. This is an engineering reconstruction check, not a full real-model interval certificate.
numerical_rules.integral_endpoint_check: Sequential charge/extrema/time must match the input-only scan bit-for-bit; saved-free endpoint SOC and legacy round-trip checked at gamma(64) operand scale.
numerical_rules.cost_resolution: allowance=gamma(8*N+64)*(S_cost_frozen+S_cost_replacement)+gamma(8)*(abs(L_frozen)+abs(L_replacement)+abs(prior_frozen)+abs(prior_replacement)); S_cost are the evaluator compensated absolute computed summand scales. Difference evaluated by math.fsum of the four signed terms.
numerical_rules.arithmetic_scope: The allowance concerns accumulation and combination of computed residual-square terms and fixed reported prior-cost values. It does not bound model recurrence, libm, residual/J products or the prior log-density evaluation against exact real arithmetic. No global likelihood-fidelity certificate is asserted.

transaction.observations_owned: Exactly source_id:[0,252000), one active likelihood block. Prior is outside this block and owned once.
transaction.before: Generation0: old block and frozen candidate.
transaction.acceptance: All input/source/parity/domain/resource checks pass, both candidates finite and strictly feasible, and F_frozen-F_replacement exceeds the frozen arithmetic-resolution allowance. Both surrogate solves need not be KKT-converged.
transaction.unresolved_or_worse: Retain generation0 and old block/candidate; record signed difference and solver statuses. No new solve, anchor, threshold or pass.
transaction.after: If accepted generation1 replaces old block with new block and candidate; prior and observation cursor unchanged. Do not add the two likelihood approximations or the old recursive posterior.
transaction.interpretation: A feasible-point computed-objective improvement is a transaction witness, not a MAP/global optimum or posterior-fidelity/coverage result.

resources.qualification_scope: Build and fabricated qualification are separately recorded before canonical execution and are not canonical calls.
resources.CPU_scope: Canonical supervisor RUSAGE_SELF plus all waited children, including bookkeeping. Exact child wait4 also recorded.
resources.wall_scope: From canonical supervisor start through final receipt accounting; no blocking wait beyond remaining budget.

failure: Reserve an exclusive attempt directory before validation. Preserve every launched child stdout/stderr/resource record, per-solve markers and input identities. Any nonzero child exit, malformed/nonfinite output, input mutation, model-domain failure, parity failure or cap breach stops the remaining sequence. Finite strictly feasible KKT-unresolved solves are retained and audited under the predeclared policy.

reporting.source: Separate read-only reducer after complete closed execution
reporting.truth: At most one original archived endpoint truth record after source hash, closed receipt and all output identities verified; never an inference input.
reporting.shape: Keep gradients and raw full matrices. Only PD/interior inverse-curvature shape scales may be shown; retain unresolved and nonstationary labels. No candidate-centered uncertainty intervals or truth-in-interval coverage checks. Audit Gram+prior Hessian is Gauss-Newton, not exact nonlinear Hessian.
reporting.prior_derivative_reconstruction: At most two explicitly counted post-inference prior algebra evaluations for shape/gradient reporting; no model or optimizer call.
reporting.whole_process_closure: Require execution_process/receipt.json to record root exit0 and whole-process wait4 CPU/wall/RSS within frozen limits, including the internal result/receipt close. This outer launcher invokes the canonical supervisor once and performs no inference itself.

failure_closure.semantics: If the ordinary cumulative output cap is breached, stop inference and preserve a bounded failure result/manifest even if this diagnostic closure adds bytes beyond that cap. Record failed status, cap breach and actual retained bytes; never discard evidence or report resource compliance. The emergency allowance is failure-only and cannot authorize another model pass or solve.
